name: La Vecilla (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue with a broad white stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Vecilla (a bridge above waves and stars).
history: Municipal flag of La Vecilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
